title: Topic 3.2: The Temptations of Jesus Christ

pages.lesson:
LESSON: THE TEMPTATIONS OF JESUS CHRIST

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.2: The Temptations of Jesus Christ

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on The Temptations of Jesus Christ. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How did Jesus Christ overcome the temptations He faced in the wilderness?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify temptations they face as young people today

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: THE TEMPTATIONS OF JESUS CHRIST
This lesson teaches The Temptations of Jesus Christ for Grade 6 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify temptations they face as young people today
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe The Temptations of Jesus Christ using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about The Temptations of Jesus Christ above.
2. Explain The Temptations of Jesus Christ to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand The Temptations of Jesus Christ.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Temptations of Jesus Christ with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is The Temptations of Jesus Christ important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How did Jesus Christ overcome the temptations He faced in the wilderness?
2. How do you overcome temptations as a young person?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify temptations they face as young people today

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
